blurb: Guests experience a personal hot air balloon flight with a maximum of 2 or 4 passengers per balloon. Flights operate from mid/late October to the end of April, avoiding summer months for safety. The company offers standard and private sweetheart flights.
extraNote: Cash payment price $300 per passenger, credit card $315 per passenger · Sweetheart flight $900 cash, $935 credit card · Do not operate during summer months due to safety concerns with high temperatures · Mid/Late October to end of April
